settings.name: Setting

errors.number: A whole number from 0 to {max}, please.
errors.percents: Whole percentages from 1 to 100, at most ten, separated by commas.

settings.note: A change holds at once, with no deploy. Admins are exempt from the member limits, never from the site budget.

mode.name: Who may join
mode.about: Invitation only: every new account needs an invitation. Open: an email address proved with a code is enough.

maxPerDay.name: New accounts a day
maxPerDay.about: Past it, joining waits for the next UTC day, whatever the mode.
maxPerDay.value: {n, plural, =0 {None: joining is paused} other {# a day}}

translationsPerDay.name: New translations per member
translationsPerDay.about: Posts a member's requests pay to translate in a UTC day. One already translated for someone else is free; the rest wait for the next day.

feedsPerDay.name: New feeds per member
feedsPerDay.about: Feeds new to Tela a member adds in a UTC day, a claim's included. Following a feed Tela already has is free; an import's extra feeds wait for the next days.

maxSubscriptions.name: Subscriptions per account
maxSubscriptions.about: The most blogs one account follows.

unsubscribedPostsPerDay.name: Posts from unfollowed blogs per member
unsubscribedPostsPerDay.about: Posts a member opens in full in a UTC day from blogs they don’t subscribe to, on the web and in their apps together. Their own subscriptions are never counted. It slows anyone copying Tela wholesale.
unsubscribedPostsPerDay.value: {n, plural, =0 {None} one {# post a day} other {# posts a day}}

siteDailyTokens.name: Site translation budget
siteDailyTokens.about: Model tokens for everyone's titles and posts together in a UTC day. Once it is spent, translations already running finish and new ones wait for the next day.
siteDailyTokens.value: {n, plural, =0 {None: translation waits} other {{tokens} tokens a day}}

backgroundDailyTokens.name: Title translation budget
backgroundDailyTokens.about: Model tokens for titles in a UTC day, inside the site budget. Unset, tela-jobs' LLM_DAILY_BUDGET_TOKENS decides, where 0 means no limit.
backgroundDailyTokens.value: {n, plural, =0 {None: titles wait} other {{tokens} tokens a day}}

signupsPerDay.name: Sign-up alert
signupsPerDay.about: Mails you once when more than this many people join in a UTC day.
signupsPerDay.value: {n, plural, =0 {At the first sign-up} other {More than # in a day}}

budgetPercents.name: Budget alerts
budgetPercents.about: Mails you once a day as the site budget's spending passes each share.

enabled.name: Approved apps
enabled.about: Off stops every connected app at once: each request is answered “unavailable” until it is on again. Connections are kept.
